name: Liron Treye's Journal
body:
Source Dungeoneer's Handbook pg. 15
Price 4,600 gp; Accuracy +6
Category Dungeon Guides
Associated Skill Knowledge (religion) (DC 25)
Description
This long-lost tome contains all of Liron Treye’s accounts of the mysterious and terrible things found in Kalexcourt of Ustalav when he explored the haunted burial ground centuries ago.
Skill Bonuses
See through a vampire or dhampir’s disguise (Perception +4)
Recite Ustalavic apologue or adage (Diplomacy +2)
